name: Shitagi o Nuide, Toukou Shitara
original_name: 下着を脱いで、登校したら
source:
Someone accidentally sees up Rin's skirt, and this makes her think of something new. She'd been bored anyway, so she decides to do a bit of exhibitionism.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE048673.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有人意外看见了凛的裙底，这让她萌生了一个新想法。反正她正觉得无聊，于是决定尝试一点露出游戏。

[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE048673.html]DLsite English[/url]]
